task: put the wine bottle on top of the cabinet

windows.text: Hold the open gripper stationary above the table, positioned near the wine bottle and bowl.
Approach the wine bottle from above, lowering the open gripper toward its neck.
Approach the wine bottle from above, lowering the open gripper around its neck.
Grasp the wine bottle by closing the gripper around its neck while it stands on the table.
Grasp the wine bottle by its neck and lift it vertically off the table.
Lift the wine bottle up off the table, raising it above the metal bowl.
Lift the wine bottle up off the table, raising it above the bowl.
Carry the wine bottle horizontally over the dark cabinet toward its top surface.
Release the wine bottle onto the top surface of the cabinet.
Open the gripper and readjust above the wine bottle resting on the cabinet.
